_comment: Copy this file to models.json (gitignored) and edit freely. Keys starting with underscore are documentation only and are ignored by the loader. Valid roles: router, vision, code, reasoning, critic, copilot_gpu, copilot_cpu. On 8 GB VRAM, stay in the same size class as the defaults (approx 0.5-8B quantized). Custom models should be preloaded with huggingface_hub.snapshot_download before use.

_example_custom._comment: This key is ignored (underscore prefix). To use a custom model: copy to a real key name (e.g. mycoder), set hf_id, preload weights, then point a role at it.
